`pub use crate::REGEN_ADDRESS_PIN as REGEN`. The walk collected constants by
name and never followed a `use ... as`, so it answered NO VERDICT for `studio`
and the side-workspace gate exited 1 on a tree nothing in this repository had
changed. The walk now gives every alias the values of what it renames.
THE ONE INJECTION removes that step. The renamed-constant law must go red and
the plain-constant law beside it, selected by the same filter, must not — it
is the control that says the red is about the rename and not about constants.
